jobs.title: Vice President of Finance
jobs.description:
We are seeking a strategic, commercially oriented, and transformational Vice President of Finance to lead the business finance function across our Strategic Business Units and Segments. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer and working from our Pittsburgh, PA headquarters, you will play a pivotal role in elevating the rigor, discipline, business partnership, and impact of our finance organization as well as partnering with the CEO and CFO on key operational initiatives.

As our Vice President of Finance, you will lead a team of Finance Directors and serve as the primary catalyst for strengthening financial performance management, accelerating profitable growth, optimizing working capital, and enhancing commercial excellence across the enterprise. You will drive a step change in how finance supports business decision-making by creating a more proactive, data-driven, engaged, and influential finance organization.

You will work closely with senior business leadership, Corporate Strategy, Controllership, Treasury, Tax, M&A, Investor Relations, and other Finance Centers of Excellence to ensure world-class financial stewardship while enabling growth and value creation.

PPG offers excellent Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits; matching 401k + retirement savings; and Paid Vacation, Holiday pay.

Main Responsibilities:
Enterprise Business Partnership
- Serve as the senior finance leader and trusted advisor to business leadership across our Strategic Business Units and Segments as well as corporate functions.
- Drive fact-based decision making by providing actionable financial insights, strategic guidance, and performance analysis.
- Challenge business assumptions and influence operating decisions to maximize shareholder value.

Financial Performance and Profitability
- Lead efforts to improve profitability through disciplined performance management, pricing excellence, margin expansion initiatives, and resource allocation.
- Establish greater accountability and rigor around financial commitments, forecasts, business reviews, and performance interventions.
- Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for growth, productivity, and operational improvement.

Working Capital Excellence
- Drive enterprise focus on working capital optimization, including inventory management, receivables performance, and cash generation.
- Establish clear performance metrics and accountability mechanisms to improve cash conversion and capital efficiency.

Finance Function Transformation
- Elevate the capabilities, engagement, and effectiveness of the business finance organization.
- Build a highly proactive finance team that acts as a strategic business partner rather than a traditional reporting function.
- Develop new standards for financial analysis, forecasting accuracy, decision support, and timely management insights enabled by better data, dashboards, and analytics.

Leadership of Finance Directors
- Lead and develop Finance Directors supporting our business units and segments as well as corporate functions.
- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and talent development.
- Build a robust pipeline of finance talent through intentional succession planning, stretch assignments, mentoring, and development of high-potential leaders across business units, segments, and corporate functions.
- Ensure consistency of financial practices while encouraging innovation and business partnership excellence.

Cross-Functional Finance Leadership
- Coordinate closely with Controllership and other Finance Centers of Excellence to ensure business finance activities are aligned with enterprise processes, reporting requirements, and governance expectations.
- Partner across Treasury, Tax, Investor Relations, M&A, and Corporate Strategy to deliver integrated financial leadership.
- Champion best practices and leverage enterprise-wide financial expertise to improve business outcomes.

Strategic Planning and Investment Decision Support
- Lead the financial aspects of strategic planning, annual operating plans, long-range planning, and investment decision support.
- Develop and evaluate robust business cases for capital investments, growth opportunities, acquisitions, and strategic initiatives, ensuring clear assumptions, financial rigor, risk assessment, and value creation expectations.
- Provide financial analysis and recommendations that support enterprise prioritization, while ensuring business-sponsored investments are aligned with strategic objectives and return expectations.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field required
- MBA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent advanced qualification preferred
- 15+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within a global, complex organization
- Demonstrated success leading business finance organizations and partnering directly with senior operating executives
- Strong track record of driving profitability improvement, performance management, and business transformation
- Experience leading large, geographically dispersed teams
- Deep understanding of commercial finance, FP&A, financial operations, and strategic planning

How we work: At PPG, we bring teams together to accelerate collaboration and career development, with in-person work Monday through Thursday and the opportunity to work remotely on Flexible Fridays. Schedules may vary by location.

jobs.location: VNM - Ho Chi Minh City Office
jobs.description:

This is a rare opportunity to step into a critical P&L leadership role with full commercial accountability for a complex, and fast-growing regional business. You will lead a talented team across 7 dynamic SEA markets, drive a bold growth agenda, and shape the future of PPG's Industrial Coatings presence in the region. You will be reporting to President, PPG AP, and Vice President, Industrial Coatings, Asia Pacific and Global Consumer Products.

Key Responsibilities

- Driv e   Business Growth & Profitability

- Own the full P&L (~USD 60M) across SEA, delivering revenue, volume, margin, and EBIT targets

- Build and execute short- and long-term commercial strategies across General Industrial, Coil & Extrusion, and Powder , Wood   Coatings segments

- Identify and capture whitespace opportunities across existing and new markets

- Win & Grow Key Accounts

- Develop and execute strategic account plans for regional key accounts

- Negotiate high-value contracts and secure long-term commercial partnerships

- Personally lead senior customer relationships — from plant floor to boardroom

- Build & Lead a High-Performing Team

- Inspire, coach, and develop   a   commercial team   across six countries

- Drive a culture of accountability, customer   champion , and commercial excellence

- Build succession depth and career pathways for high   performers

- Collaborate Across the Business

- Partner closely with Regional Segment   Lead s,   Science & Technology ,   Operations, Procurement,   Supply Chain,   and Marketing to deliver integrated, value-based solutions

- Contribute as a senior leader within the IC APAC leadership team

- Champion PPG's EH&S   and compliance   standards and corporate values across all markets

Qualifications

- 12–15 years in coatings, specialty chemicals, or related industries

- Bachelor's degree in   Materials , Chemistry, or   Chemical Engineering ; MBA

- Proven track record managing multi-country P&L at   minimum   USD 40M+ scale

- Deep understanding of SEA business environments; Vietnam experiences a strong advantage

- Experience governing and developing distributor networks across diverse markets

- Fluent in English; additional SEA language proficiency is a strong advantage

jobs.title: Financial Controller Denmark
jobs.description:
Bliv en del af vores team som Financial Controller for Danmark.

Vil du være tæt på forretningen og samtidig sikre, at tallene altid er korrekte? Som Financial Controller for Danmark får du en central rolle for en finansprofil, der trives med høj faglighed, præcision og forretningsnær sparring.

Du kommer til at arbejde hands-on på tværs af hele den finansielle cyklus, fra månedsafslutning til forecasting, og du får et tæt samarbejde med Local Finance, Plant Operations og Business Finance-teams. Dette er ikke en rolle, hvor du leder andre eller sætter strategien på afstand. Det er en rolle, hvor din tekniske nøjagtighed, nysgerrighed og pålidelighed direkte bidrager til forretningens performance.

Du refererer til vores FP&A Finance Manager for Nordics, Baltics and Kazakhstan. Det giver dig adgang til et stærkt front-office finance team, samtidig med at du bliver understøttet af et større team i PPG’s Shared Service Center i Brno. Du får ansvar for den end-to-end månedlige rapporteringsproces og bidrager til forecasting-cyklusser i tæt samarbejde med øvrige Finance-teams. Rollen har ikke personaleansvar, så du kan fokusere fuldt ud på finansiel ekspertise, eksekvering og forretningspartnerskab.

Lokation: Søborg, Danmark

Arbejdsmodel: Hybrid

Dine ansvarsområder
- Gennemføre den fulde månedsafslutningsproces for tildelte enheder i henhold til US GAAP, herunder journal entries, accruals, provisions, intercompany transactions og reclassifications, samt sikre korrekte P&L-, balance sheet- og cash flow statements med variance analysis af høj kvalitet.
- Understøtte annual planning og periodiske forecasts ved at indsamle inputs, indlæse og afstemme tal samt opbygge driver-based models for revenue, COGS og Opex.
- Sikre nøjagtighed i P&L og proaktivt løse eventuelle problemstillinger i samarbejde med Brno Shared Service Center.
- Udarbejde forretningsanalyser og rapportering, der hjælper lokal ledelse med at forstå performance drivers og træffe informerede beslutninger.
- Understøtte konsolidering af overhead costs og fremadrettet forecasting, afstemme payroll accounting og vedligeholde detaljeret cost center reporting, herunder tracking af Opex og headcount, samt sikre korrekt dataindsendelse i ERP- og BI-værktøjer inden for fastsatte deadlines.
- Sikre høj SOX compliance og stærke internal controls gennem grundig dokumentation og control evidence, understøtte interne og eksterne audits med detaljerede schedules og forklaringer samt, efter behov, bidrage til statutory audit i samarbejde med lokale rådgivere.
- Bidrage til procesforbedringer ved at dokumentere SOPs, identificere muligheder for simplificering og understøtte automatisering i Excel og BI-værktøjer.

Kvalifikationer
- Uddannelse inden for finance, accounting eller et beslægtet område.
- 4-6 års erfaring inden for controlling, accounting eller FP&A.
- Stærk viden om US GAAP. Erfaring med SOX og internal controls er et krav.
- Avancerede Excel-kompetencer. Erfaring med SAP og Power BI er en fordel.
- Kendskab til Anaplan vil være en yderligere fordel.
- Flydende dansk og engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.
- Struktureret, detaljeorienteret og pålidelig, også når deadlines er korte.
- Trives i en global matrixorganisation.
- Hands-on tilgang og motiveret af eksekvering. Dette er en individual contributor-rolle uden direkte personaleansvar.

Det tilbyder vi
- Et internationalt arbejdsmiljø med eksponering mod Nordics, Baltics and Kazakhstan i en Fortune 500-organisation.
- Direkte samarbejde med erfarne finance leaders, som giver meningsfuld faglig udvikling fra første dag.
- Adgang til PPG’s globale learning and development-programmer.
- En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke, der matcher erfaring og markedsniveau.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Service Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At PPG, we are looking for an experienced and inspiring leader to join our Customer Service organization in EMEA. This is a unique opportunity to lead a large, multifunctional team supporting critical business operations across Customer Support, Order Management, Export Compliance, Pricing, Reporting, Data Management, Business Analysis, and Product Analysis.
As a Senior Customer Service Operations Manager, you will play a key role in shaping service delivery excellence across the region, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and building strong partnerships with business stakeholders. You will lead a team of leaders and specialists, balancing strategic priorities with operational execution while contributing to both regional and global initiatives.

This role reports to: Head of Customer Service Operations
Location: Curie-Skłodowskiej 12, Wrocław
Work Model: Minimum 3 days in the office/week

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of leaders and specialists, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
- Oversee end-to-end Customer Service operations, including order management, customer support, pricing, reporting, export compliance, and data management activities.
- Ensure efficient workload planning, resource utilization, cross-training, and operational continuity across teams.
- Build strong relationships with business stakeholders across EMEA and act as a trusted partner to internal customers.
- Drive process optimization, automation, and operational excellence initiatives to improve service quality and efficiency.
- Support the resolution of complex customer escalations and business-critical issues.
- Monitor team performance, KPIs, SLAs, and business metrics, providing insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
- Ensure data accuracy, compliance, reporting quality, and adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.
- Lead or support process transitions, organizational changes, and continuous improvement projects.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align customer service activities with business priorities and strategic goals.
- Promote PPG values and foster a culture of engagement, learning, and development.

Our Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience; Master's degree is a plus.
- Minimum 5 years of leadership experience within Customer Service, Order Management, Shared Services, Supply Chain, or a related environment.
- Proven experience managing large teams and complex operational structures.
- Strong people leadership, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.
- Fluency in English.
- Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision making, and organizational capabilities.
- Customer- and business-oriented mindset with a focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement.
- Experience leading transformation, process improvement, or automation initiatives.
- Strong proficiency with MS Office and experience working with ERP, CRM, and reporting tools.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive results in a dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Director
jobs.description:
As the Sales Operations Director, you will serve as a strategic partner to the PMC Leadership Team, driving commercial effectiveness through analytics, forecasting, sales process optimization, and operational governance. This role will influence commercial decision-making by establishing global standards, providing actionable business insights, and fostering alignment across regional commercial organizations.
*Role is availabile in Pittsburgh, or office in Poland.

Key Responsibilities
- Data Analysis: Generate and create reports that provide insights to sales managers and executives, helping them make informed decisions and develop effective sales and pricing strategies. Analyze sales performance, pricing trends, price realization, customer profitability, and market dynamics to identify opportunities for growth and margin improvement. Create plans for monthly and quarterly performance rollups.
- Forecasting:  Support IBP process owner and annual and quarterly forecasting activities aligned to committed financial plans
- Lead annual targeting setting process using commercial and market intelligence to develop individual growth goals
- Territory and Quota Management: Align with regional commercial leadership to develop territory, account coverage, and quota recommendations. Utilize commercial analytics and market intelligence to support equitable account distribution and alignment with growth objectives while ensuring consistency with global sales operations standards.
- Sales Compensation Management: Partner with the finance and HR departments to design and administer sales compensation plans.  Ensure that commission structures are fair, accurate, and aligned with the organization's goals.
- Sales and Commercial Training:  Design effective training plans supporting sales incentive training and utilization of commercial tools (e.g. PowerBI, Sales Force, Varicent).
- Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders across many levels of the organization to drive adoption of best practices and support achievement of business objectives.

Qualifications / Prior Experiences
- Bachelor’s Degree
- 5+ years commercial operations and selling experience
- Demonstrated success leading through influence in a matrixed, global organization.
- In-depth knowledge of sales technologies /CRMs
- Extensive knowledge of commercial process and work flows
- Working knowledge of pricing analytics, price realization, and profitability analysis preferred.
- Prior experience administering sales compensation plans

jobs.title: Operations Director, Aerospace Transparencies
jobs.description:
As the Operations Director for Aerospace Transparencies, you will develop and maintain an organization for the Global Transparencies business that supports both Commercial and Operational strategies.  You will be responsible for providing strategic, developmental, and tactical direction of the business to drive Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement. Is responsible for delivering products safely, on quality, on time and at targeted costs with oversite of operations and supply chain. You will report to the GM of Global Transparencies. This is a hybrid position can be based out of Sylmar, CA, Grand Prairie, TX., or Huntsville, AL.

You will manage:
- 4 Manufacturing Sites in 2 different Countries (Sylmar CA, Huntsville AL, Grand Prairie, TX in the USA & Casaletto Vaprio, Italy)

- The Transparencies Supply Chain CoE Manager

Key Responsibilities
- Be actively engaged in Safety and Quality; lead by example and ensure operational discipline and compliance with both company and regulatory standards and requirements are fulfilled for all departments on site.

- Regularly monitor and review Environmental, Health, and Safety performance; ensure compliance and continuous improvement in striving for a risk-free manufacturing environment.

- Build and develop an operations and supply chain culture that has a bias for action, commitment to value-added services/processes, and a sense of accountability and leadership.

- Monitor and improve Key Performance Indicators; lead corrective action to deviations to plan as appropriate.

- Facilitate communications throughout the sites and within the respective Business, Program, and Functional teams offsite.

jobs.title: Program Manager – Aerospace Transparencies
jobs.description:
Program Manager – Aerospace Transparencies
Huntsville, AL

Are you a passionate and driven Program Manager who is looking to take their career to new heights?  Then look no further than this opportunity with PPG's Aerospace business! We are looking for someone who is able to see the future of aviation transparencies and take our exceptional products to the next level!

In the Aerospace Transparencies Program Manager  role you will be responsible for overseeing the program lifecycle management (PLM) from concept through development into sustainable production and into sunset of aerospace transparencies for fixed wing aircraft and rotorcraft applications (military and commercial). In this role you will be involved in managing cross-functional teams, coordinating with suppliers and customers, ensuring compliance with aerospace standards, and driving program schedules, budgets, and quality objectives to successful completion for a portfolio of programs.

This is a On-site role reporting to the Huntsville, AL facility.  In this role you will report to the Site Lead -  Program Manager.

Responsibilities:
- Lead end-to-end program management across the PLM lifecycle (Gates 2-7), driving new product introduction, production, sustainment, and sunset activities while meeting customer requirements, business objectives, budget, schedule, quality, and performance targets.
- Develop and execute integrated program plans, including schedules, budgets, resource allocation, capital funding requirements, forecasts, and gate reviews, with authority to approve or fail program gates and implement corrective actions as needed.
- Build, lead, and coordinate cross-functional Integrated Project Teams (IPTs) across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, R&D, and Operations to ensure seamless program execution and value stream alignment.
- Serve as the primary customer interface for all programmatic activities throughout the product lifecycle, leading stakeholder engagement, negotiating technical changes, supporting commercial and contract activities, and ensuring customer satisfaction.
- Oversee NPI and sustaining production activities, including product design maturation, tooling development, EMD/LRIP/FRP transitions, BOM/BOO and process documentation, NRE efforts, demand forecasting, proposal support, and technical/financial program reviews.
- Identify, assess, and mitigate program risks while driving continuous improvement initiatives and best practices to maintain schedule adherence, cost performance, operational efficiency, and manufacturing transparency.
- Ensure compliance with customer requirements, industry regulations (FAA, EASA, MIL-STD), and internal quality standards, while providing regular executive-level reporting on program status, financial performance, schedule health, and risk assessments.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related discipline required.
- Aerospace specific industry experience is preferred.
- Minimum of Five (5) years of program management or engineering experience in aerospace or defense industries, with specific experience in transparencies or related components.
- Strong knowledge of aerospace transparency materials (e.g., acrylics, polycarbonates, glass), manufacturing processes, and testing methods preferred.
- PMP (Project Management Professional) certification strongly preferred
- Travel 10% - may include international travel.
- Only U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, and political asylees or refugees are eligible to apply

jobs.title: Store Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Store Operations Manager
Basildon
Full Time | Permanent

As a Store Operations Manager within our Johnstone's Decorating Centre, you will lead from the front. With responsibility for driving and growing sales, you will ensure that all operating standards achieve the expected level of excellence.

Within this role you will provide outstanding Customer Service and support within your store, always demonstrating a positive customer focused attitude.

What we can offer...
- Competitive starting salary
- Competitive bonus structure starting at 12% for achieving budget, with potential to earn up to 42% of your salary for overachieving budget
- 35 days of annual leave, including bank holidays
- Guaranteed 39 hours pay per week with overtime or lieu time available
- Great work/life balance: Our stores are closed Saturday afternoons and Sundays, with no late evenings after 5pm!
- Generous company pension contributions
- Excellent career progression: We develop our people with online opportunities and the PPG Training Academy
- Fantastic company-funded private healthcare plan, with options to extend coverage to family members
- Generous staff discount on paint and decorating tools at Johnstone’s Decorating Centre
- Colleague recognition program that recognises and rewards our colleagues
- Inclusive and engaging workplace – We foster a culture of inclusion for all (Our engagement scores show it!)
- Colleague assistance programme for 24/7 wellbeing support and cycle to work scheme

Key Responsibilities:
•    Achieving expected sales and profit targets within store to ensure Company profitability.
•    Providing day to day management of the Sales Assistants which will include the organisation and planning of both working rotas and absence planners. The number of direct reports will vary dependent on size of store.
•    Providing training to all new and existing colleagues and coaching where necessary.
•    Working Operational Managers to control resources in line with budgeted costs.
•    Maintaining a high level of security, and full compliance with Company policies within the store in regards to stock, financial transactions, security and premises.
•    Handling of the Decorating Centre accounts within the agreed company guidelines and policy.
•    Ensuring that Health & Safety standards are maintained at all times.
•    Carrying out any required recruitment and selection procedures in liaison with the District Operations Manager.

Qualifications
•    Previous experience in a customer facing environment delivering on direct sales.
•    Strong leadership, mentoring and motivational skills with previous supervisory and or management experience.
•    Demonstrates the ability to stay calm and composed when dealing with difficult situations.
•    Flexibility in attitude towards both working hours and duties, providing cover for the other Decorating Centres in the Zone as required.

jobs.description:
$As the Assistant Operations Manager, you will have managerial responsibility over the engineering and sub-standard product recovery function of the production teams at the Cleveland plant including safe and efficient operation of production systems. You will work onsite in Cleveland, OH and you will report to the Operations Manager.

Main responsibilities:
- Own process quality and process incident investigation and ensure root cause analysis and corrective actions are established.
- Manage a team of ~20-25 headcount across 24/7 shifts: Engineers (~8 HC), a small lab (~4 HC), and a scheduling team (~11 HC).
- Deliver year over year improvements in non-conforming product and formula/specification optimization
- Work with technical, process engineering team, and production team to match output to standards. Establish criteria for bad actor production and drive for improvement on these metrics.
- Develop and implement long-term strategies for quality/cost improvement.
- Partner with Maintenance/Engineering for all expense and capital work required to maintain operations.
- Analyze data to provide inventive ideas and execute swiftly with minimal oversight

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, chemistry, or equivalent is required
- 5+ years of manufacturing operations management experience strongly preferred
- Experience with LEAN or Six Sigma
- Ability to flex schedule to follow batches when customer impact is involved

jobs.description:
As the Operational Excellence Training Coordinator, you will help drive plant performance by managing key continuous improvement and operation excellence initiatives for operations and supporting operator training and development.

You will be onsite at the Circleville, OH plant and will report to the Operations Manager. PPG offers excellent Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits; matching 401k + retirement savings; and Paid Vacation, Holiday pay.

Responsibilities:
- Complete evaluations for employee training and cross training for reactor operator, material processor, and warehouse groups.

- Develop training plans and help manage training timelines.

- Present site training initiatives in group and individual settings.

- Site SME for Training ETQ management and help maintain training documentation to ensure training compliance for site.

- Certified to complete training on plant equipment (forklift, yard bird, lifts, etc.)

- Assist training coordinator in maintaining plant training initiatives.

- Coordinate and execute operations initiatives and projects to improve safety, quality, service and costs.

- Drive standard processes and procedures throughout the department with education and best practices.

- Communicate and escalate issues to technical and leadership team to keep organization apprised of manufacturing status.

- High School diploma or GED required, bachelor's degree preferred

- 5 years of chemical manufacturing experience desired

- Knowledge and support of EHS and Quality systems

- Ability to lead, develop, and motivate others

- Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and accountability

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
jobs.description:
As the  Continuous Improvement Specialist,  reporting to the Maintenance and Continuous Improvement Manager, you will coordinate process and lead the execution of continuous improvement strategy of the site. You will deliver main CI initiatives, influence engineers and operators to utilize CI best practices, research, and execute CI projects. You will work out of the Greensboro PPG Production Facility. This is an on-site position.

Key Responsibilities:
- Assess and deploy CI development plans and set goals, responsibilities, and define KPI targets with site business strategy.
- Identify, scope, and implement CI projects; responsibilities include project selection, scope and overall assignment, launch, prioritization tracking and deliverables.
- Work with leaders, engineers, and operators to coach CI methodologies.
- Ensure the instruction and use of best practices (e.g., LSS, kaizen, DMAIC, GB/YB, 5S, value stream mapping).
- Conduct LSS Assessments, define action plans to close gaps and track execution across departments.
- Work with Operators to ensure they are trained and assist them as they improve manufacturing efficiencies utilizing best practice CI tools/techniques.
- Align with Quality Assurance to deliver cost-effective end-to-end processes.
- Travel throughout the region at least 50% of the time.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in engineering or other suitable technical field, Master's degree preferred
- 2+ years proven experience with LSS/Continuous Improvement in a chemical / food / manufacturing environment
- Green belt six sigma
